text:
Carmen: Quick pulse: field is asking for a clear upgrade policy for private deploys. they want options for 'no-public-ip-change' and a documented rollback window.
Devon: Customers care about IP preservation during upgrades. propose an 'egress-preserve' installer flag and a console toggle.
Tariq: We experimented with a relay proxy that keeps outbound IPs stable by routing through a static egress box. worked in lab but token refresh crashed under load. needs circuit-breaker.
NetOps-Rachel: Suggest adding an egress-canary that runs pre/post-upgrade and reports IPs to an external endpoint. also include an automated alert if IP differs.
Carmen: Proposed lanes: operator (k8s), vm-installer (offline), relay-proxy (nat). Acceptance criteria draft:
- operator & vm-installer: minor upgrades with visible pre/post egress check and documented rollback steps
- relay-proxy: v1 shim that supports ip-preserve toggle + /diag endpoint
Devon: Prioritization: relay-shim = low effort, high field unblock; eg-preserve flag + console = medium effort, high impact; operator zero-downtime = high effort.
Tariq: I'll own relay hardening spike. plan to add retry/backoff for token refresh and expose metrics.
BuildBot: ci:nightly build 2025.2.7 will include relay-proxy prototype deploy to staging at 1751250000.
Carmen: Next steps: Tariq spike (EOW), Devon wire a console toggle mock, Rachel draft canary probe. We'll review Wed 9am with GTM. :thumbsup:
